entries.fbb4f30d858dcb43: The medium-term management plan is structured so that the company aims to be a top runner in wireless-controlled solution lighting in its core Lighting Equipment Business, while concentrating resources on Asia and the UK overseas and on solution proposals leveraging rentals in the environment-related business.

entries.ffb7b66300f27fa7: As its long-term vision, the company has set 'Toward Becoming the No.1 Leading Company in Ethical Solutions', and its 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2025-2027' has three pillars, 'Creating High-Value-Added Spaces', 'Strengthening Global Competitiveness' and 'Expanding Business Domains', with a target of consolidated revenue of ¥61 billion in fiscal 2027. In the domestic lighting business, the company says it will expand its lighting control and network solution products and strengthen proposal-based sales; in the overseas lighting business, it will concentrate management resources on Asia and the UK; and in the environment-related business, it will strengthen its solution proposal capabilities. The company also says that, through a business alliance with Advantage Partners, Inc., it aims to achieve its medium-term management plan by drawing on external expertise and management support.
